title: Cut-Out Detail Chiffon Ruffle Sleeve Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant midi dress pairs a softly pleated bodice with delicate lace trim for a romantic, polished look. The V-neckline frames the upper body beautifully, while the flutter sleeves add light coverage and graceful movement. Finished with a defined waist and flowing skirt, it is a lovely choice for weddings, garden venues, bridal showers, and other special occasions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is slightly stretchy.
